currency_source_definition: sum of activity_rewards.json event amounts under each profile.activity_plan; no free daily click grant
profession_exp_source: config.json systems.professions; 20*level, daily1000 cap, trivial recipes25%
garden_source: planting_recipes.json; simulated collection at fixed daily intervals; correct seed costs/caps, care20% time reduction and pest25% with80%handled chance
plot_purchase_source: garden_plots.json; realm condition, sequential purchase, manual exchange only if model policy explicitly invokes it
craft_source: crafting_recipes.json; actual ingredients/fees, learning price, native currency, success rate and failure EXP
auction_model: matched counterparty wallet; bid transfer never counted as system currency creation; listing fees1% and seller tax5% counted as sink
combat_model: actual reference fight at profile.gate_gear; failures with lethal death reset life assets, garden and profession XP; recipe knowledge remains
major_quest_timing: scripted expected completion when stage threshold reached; not a replacement for quest-engine event validation
progression_assumption: XP progress follows configured stage durations; no extra speed benefit credited from craft/pills to avoid unverified compounding
spend_safety: do not force optional spending if it would make wallet negative; main quest route has guaranteed evidence and no mandatory paid item
unmodeled: skillful combat decisions beyond scripted AI
whole skill-tree/affix combat effectiveness; gear profile is an explicit scenario input
raw ingredient quality assumed common; actual handler adds0..300bp quality shift from raw-item grades
metric_basis: report each currency separately and exact LT_HP-equivalent; never sum raw units across currencies
combat_consumables: 2 bound preparation pills granted once per life by Q-HG-04/Q-LG-03/Q-TG-04 before boss; no sale/trade; additional doses may be bought explicitly; actual uses consumed
active_minutes_included: raw gather3min/unit + craft30sec/attempt + task5min/day + gift15sec + bulk collection30sec
